# Submission Package: C(15, 8, 4) = 30 Cyclic Covering Design

**Recipient:** Dan Gordon (La Jolla Covering Repository)  
**Channel:** Official Web Repository (https://dmgordon.org/cover/)  
**Status:** `pending_human_submission`  
**Corresponding Author:** Alexandre Zanata (EvoByte Project, https://github.com/AlexandreZanata/EvoByte)  
**Target:** $C(15, 8, 4) = 30$  
**Record:** Matches the world record bound of 30 blocks (Gordon, 1996)  

## Mathematical Contribution
An alternative, highly symmetric algebraic realization of $C(15, 8, 4) = 30$ generated by exactly **2 base blocks** under the cyclic group action $Z_{15}$:
- **Base Block 1 (1-indexed):** $(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11, 13)$
- **Base Block 2 (1-indexed):** $(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12)$

Together, the orbits of these two base blocks cover all $\binom{15}{4} = 1,365$ quadruples of $1..15$ in exactly $15 + 15 = 30$ blocks.
